account.check_email.title: Check your inbox
account.check_email.lede: We sent you a link to confirm your address.

account.resend.title: Send the email again
account.resend.lede: Enter your address and we will send a confirmation link.
account.forgot.title: Forgot your password?
account.forgot.lede: We will send you a link to set a new password.
account.forgot.hint: The link is valid for two hours.
account.reset.title: New password
account.reset.lede: Set a new password for your account.
account.profile.email_hint: The new address takes effect after you confirm it by the link in the email.
account.profile.delete_hint: Favourites, wishlist and inventory are removed with the account.
